evidence.observation: Pressure 2.903 Torr at start of growth, in line with the ramp plateau of about 2.90 Torr
Pressure rose steadily to 3.184 Torr (about +0.07 Torr per 120 s) over 480 s of growth
Ar flow steady at about 100 sccm, matching setpoint, so the extra pressure is not from extra inflow
Thermocouple steady at 750 °C after a small overshoot to 760 °C
Heater power creeping up from 39.3% to 45.5% at constant temperature, which fits a change in the gas in the tube
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed; growth atmosphere cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 or leak-check reading would separate an air leak (O2 rises) from an exhaust or pump blockage (no O2). A leak-up test (isolate the tube and watch the pressure rate) or a check of the exhaust line and pump would also decide it.
